extracted.name: S.O.S Sh** on a Shingle”
extracted.description: My grandma always made this, when I was growing up I know it as Creamy Hamburger Gravy (is an old-school meal. ) and sometime she called it S.O.S. She tend to make this at the end of the weeks before my grandpa got his paycheck. I make this from time to time. She never showed me how to make it or anything I just remembered watching her make it. As a kid it was one of my favorites not really sure why. I tend to make this when I miss my grandparents. I only have one kid who likes it, but he eats about anything. So this recipe is dedicated to my grandparents....
instruction_lines: In a medium sauce pan over medium high heat, brown the ground beef.

Add in butter let it melt then Add flour and stir your making a making a roux. Should be like a paste at this point add in the milk, salt and pepper, stir occasionally until it’s bubbling and the thickness you want. Sever over toast.
Note: this is the exact same recipe I use for sausage gravy. Instead of ground beef, I substitute with hot, ground breakfast sausage.
